headings.title: Mandatory posting and delivery of mining terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires mineral landowners and lessees permitting mining to post printed terms and deliver copies upon request.

headings.title: Acceptance of terms, forfeiture, and reentry
headings.reviewNote: Deems miners bound by posted terms, authorizes owner reentry upon noncompliance, and negates waiver from receipt of ore.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 subsection headings for 444.010 governing mandatory posting of mining condition statements and statutory consequences of miner acceptance and forfeiture.

headings.title: Three-year exclusive right of miners and forfeiture
headings.reviewNote: Grants miners a three-year exclusive right when terms are not posted, subject to monthly work and royalty requirements.

headings.title: Owner royalty lien and forfeiture for nonpayment
headings.reviewNote: Grants the owner or lessee a lien on all minerals dug for unpaid royalties and provides forfeiture and reentry upon failure or refusal to pay demanded royalties.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.020 governing miners' three-year exclusive mining rights when terms are not posted, mineral royalty liens, and forfeiture for unpaid royalties.

headings.title: Thirty-day notice of intention to mine
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days' published or posted notice of intention to carry on mining operations in a city, town, or village.

headings.title: Contents of notice and bond presentation date
headings.reviewNote: Specifies description of locality, mining nature, and date to present the indemnity bond to the circuit court.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 subsection headings for 444.110 governing publication of mining notices in municipalities and required notice contents.

headings.title: Periodic court filing of surveyor mining diagram
headings.reviewNote: Requires periodic filing of a certified surveyor diagram showing the extent and character of mining drifts and excavations.

headings.title: Forfeiture of mining privileges upon failure
headings.reviewNote: Mandates forfeiture of mining privileges upon failure to file complete diagram upon three days' notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.170 governing periodic county surveyor mining diagrams and forfeiture for noncompliance; source note records original-rolls word discrepancy ('their').

headings.title: Purposes of metallic minerals closure plan
headings.reviewNote: Specifies the objectives of the closure plan to contain wastes, protect structures, and achieve designated uses.

headings.title: Final designated uses of waste area
headings.reviewNote: Requires designating compatible final uses for the waste management area such as wildlife, agriculture, or industry.

headings.title: Measures to accomplish closure plan objectives
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required closure measures including surface water management, groundwater monitoring and protection, waste management structures control, vegetation, off-site removal control, and wind movement control.

headings.title: Five-year and requested review and revision of closure plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires the operator and director to review the closure plan every five years or upon owner or operator request and revise it as necessary.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.362 governing metallic minerals closure plan purposes, final designated uses, closure measures, and five-year reviews.

headings.title: Purposes of inspection and maintenance plan
headings.reviewNote: Specifies the objectives of the inspection-maintenance plan to maintain structures and environmental protection during closure.

headings.title: Measures required in inspection-maintenance plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires measures necessary to maintain designated final uses and closure plan measures, including an inspection program, access control program, and structure and vegetation maintenance program.

headings.title: Estimated duration and basis for ending active maintenance
headings.reviewNote: Requires setting forth the estimated continuation time for each measure and a proposed basis for determining when active inspection-maintenance is no longer required.

headings.title: Five-year and requested review and revision of program
headings.reviewNote: Requires the operator and director to review the inspection-maintenance program every five years or upon owner or operator request and revise it as necessary.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.365 governing inspection-maintenance plan purposes, required programs, duration estimates, and five-year reviews.

headings.title: Financial assurance demonstration and approved instruments
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing financial assurance before permit issuance via bond, certificate of deposit, letter of credit, insurance, company guarantee, escrow agreement, or other director-approved form.

headings.title: Form, per-acre penal sum, and minimum amount
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes a penal sum of one thousand dollars per acre with a twenty-thousand-dollar per-permit minimum, permitting discretionary director reduction not below the twenty-thousand-dollar minimum.

headings.title: Duration of financial assurance until closure release
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the financial assurance instrument remains in effect until the area is closed, approved, and released by the director.

headings.title: Execution of bonds by licensed corporate surety
headings.reviewNote: Requires any furnished bond to be signed by the operator as principal and by a licensed Missouri corporate surety.

headings.title: Ninety-day cancellation notice and substitution requirement
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits cancelling or terminating financial assurance without at least ninety days' notice and director-approved substitution, and bars operating without approved assurance.

headings.title: Company guarantee letter and Missouri property valuation test
headings.reviewNote: Requires a company guarantee to be executed by a company officer with a financial test demonstrating Missouri real property or mining rights assessed at least three times the required assurance.

headings.title: Confidentiality of nonpublic financial test information
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director and department employees, upon written company request, to keep nonpublic financial test data submitted for other assurance forms confidential.

headings.title: Violation notice and forfeiture request after ninety days
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice of violations and authorizes the director to request forfeiture under section 444.378 if corrective measures are not commenced within ninety days.

headings.title: Director authority to conduct remedial measures after forfeiture
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to conduct remedial measures under sections 444.352 to 444.380 on land where financial assurance has been forfeited.

headings.title: Release or proportionate reduction upon completed closure
headings.reviewNote: Requires releasing the operator and releasing or proportionately reducing financial assurance upon operator notice and director determination that closure and inspection-maintenance requirements are complete.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.368 governing metallic minerals financial assurance forms, penal sums, duration, corporate sureties, cancellation notice, company guarantees, confidentiality, forfeiture, remedial work, and release.

headings.title: Application processing fee and annual permit fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires a ten-thousand-dollar processing fee with permit applications and a seven-thousand-five-hundred-dollar annual fee per facility or area until inspection-maintenance is no longer required.

headings.title: Creation of Metallic Minerals Waste Management Fund
headings.reviewNote: Credits all fees and bond forfeitures collected under sections 444.352 to 444.380 to the Metallic Minerals Waste Management Fund in the state treasury.

headings.title: Fund expenditures, investment, and three-million-dollar lapse threshold
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appropriated fund expenditures for administration, enforcement, and remediation, directs state treasurer investment with earnings retained, and exempts balances from section 33.080 lapse up to three million dollars exclusive of interest and forfeitures.

headings.title: Site-specific expenditure of forfeited financial assurance proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Requires moneys collected from any financial assurance forfeiture to be expended on the permitted area for which the instrument was given.

headings.title: Limitation on general revenue appropriations and expenditures
headings.reviewNote: Restricts appropriations or expenditures of state general revenue solely to the administration and enforcement of sections 444.352 to 444.380.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.370 governing processing and annual fees, the Metallic Minerals Waste Management Fund, investment/non-lapse rules, forfeiture use, and general revenue limits.

headings.title: Application completeness review and negotiation meeting
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to review applications, notify applicants of completeness and plan adequacy, and schedule a negotiation meeting upon applicant request.

headings.title: Ninety-day permit decision, denial conference, and final determination
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing or denying a permit within ninety days of a completed application, scheduling a negotiation conference upon denial, and serving a final determination if agreement is not reached.

headings.title: Judicial review of final department decisions under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Subjects final department orders and determinations to judicial review as administrative decisions under chapter 536 only after administrative remedies are exhausted.

headings.title: Judicial review of rule validity under section 536.050
headings.reviewNote: Directs courts in section 536.050 suits to review the commission record for rule validity and reasonableness and authorizes hearing additional evidence deemed necessary.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.372 governing director application review, ninety-day permit decisions and denial conferences, chapter 536 judicial review, and section 536.050 rule review.

headings.title: Director duty to investigate statutory and permit compliance
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to cause investigations to determine compliance with sections 444.350 to 444.380 and issued permits.

headings.title: Right of entry, obstruction bar, and search warrants
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes entry during normal working times for inspections, prohibits refusing entry or obstructing inspectors, and permits permit suspension and probable-cause search warrants if access is denied.

headings.title: Suits for unpermitted operations, civil penalties, and settlements
headings.reviewNote: Directs investigations of all waste management areas and attorney general suits for injunctions and up to one-thousand-dollar daily civil penalties (barred if section 444.376 administrative penalties were assessed), with Cole County or local venue and written settlement rules.

headings.title: Notice of violation and conciliation procedures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes conference and conciliation, followed by written notice of violation and formal complaints.

headings.title: Entry of final administrative order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to enter final orders revoking permits or ordering cessation upon hearing or default.

headings.title: Restriction on reissuance after revocation
headings.reviewNote: Bars issuing permits to persons whose permits were revoked until violations are corrected to the director's satisfaction.

headings.title: Civil actions for injunction and penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to request the attorney general to institute civil actions for injunctions, penalties, or bond forfeiture.

headings.title: Emergency cessation orders for imminent danger
headings.reviewNote: Directs immediate cessation orders upon finding conditions posing imminent public danger or significant environmental harm.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.375 governing compliance investigations, inspection entry and warrants, unpermitted operation suits, violation notices, final orders, revocation bars, civil enforcement, and emergency cessation orders.

headings.title: Discretionary assessment of administrative penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative penalties after conference, conciliation, and persuasion, prohibits penalties for minor violations (with specified exceptions if resolved), and waives state collection if the order omits required statutory, collection, or appeal statements.

headings.title: Rulemaking matrix, payment terms, and surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Requires penalty matrix rules reflecting RCRA 42 U.S.C. 6928(a), sets a sixty-day payment deadline stayed by chapter 536 appeal, imposes a fifteen-percent surcharge plus ten-percent annual interest, directs Article IX section 7 disposition, and authorizes circuit court collection.

headings.title: Statute of limitations and state contribution bar
headings.reviewNote: Bars increasing penalties caused by department action and requires assessment within two years of discovery.

headings.title: Election between administrative and civil penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the state to elect between administrative penalties and civil court action initiated by prosecutors.

headings.title: Judicial review of administrative penalty orders
headings.reviewNote: Subjects final administrative penalty orders to judicial review upon the filing of a petition pursuant to section 536.100.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 5 subsection headings for 444.376 governing administrative penalty assessments, penalty rules and surcharges, limitations periods, civil remedy election, and judicial review.

headings.title: Contested case record requirement
headings.reviewNote: Designates hearings under the metallic minerals waste management act as contested cases of record.

headings.title: Procedural rights of participating parties
headings.reviewNote: Grants parties the right to present oral argument, introduce evidence, and cross-examine witnesses.

headings.title: Hearing officer appointment and director decision
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to appoint a Missouri Bar member as hearing officer while reserving final decision to the director.

headings.title: Hearing notices and subpoena powers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to issue notices of hearing and subpoenas pursuant to section 536.077.

headings.title: Application of civil discovery rules
headings.reviewNote: Applies the rules of discovery governing civil cases to administrative hearings under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 5 subsection headings for 444.377 governing contested case status, party hearing rights, hearing officer appointments, subpoena authority, and civil discovery rules.

headings.title: Composition and appointment of Missouri mining commission
headings.reviewNote: Establishes an eight-member commission within DNR and specifies qualifications, ex officio members, and personnel authority.

headings.title: Staggered terms, vacancies, and removals
headings.reviewNote: Establishes initial staggered terms, four-year successor terms, vacancy filling by the governor, and removal for cause.

headings.title: Reimbursement of member travel and expenses
headings.reviewNote: Provides that commission members serve without compensation but receive reimbursement for necessary official expenses.

headings.title: Selection of officers and commission director
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual selection of chairman and vice chairman and appointment of a full-time director as administrative agent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.520 establishing Missouri Mining Commission membership, terms, expense reimbursement, and officers/director; source cross-reference notes transfer to DNR under section 640.010.

headings.title: Enumerated administrative and enforcement powers
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates commission powers including rulemaking, investigations, research, permit approvals, hearings, and orders.

headings.title: Rulemaking effectiveness pursuant to section 536.024
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no rule or portion of a rule promulgated under sections 444.530 to 444.790 becomes effective unless promulgated pursuant to section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 subsection headings for 444.530 detailing enumerated regulatory powers of the commission and rulemaking procedures.

headings.title: Mandatory reclamation rules for coal strip mining
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission rules for coal strip mining covering prime farmland restoration (exempting pre-August 3, 1977 permits), postmining land use, approximate original contour, topsoil, hydrologic balance, coal waste piles, blasting, and permanent native vegetation.

headings.title: Steep-slope strip mining rules and definition
headings.reviewNote: Requires additional steep-slope rules barring downslope debris, requiring excess spoil storage standards and highwall backfilling, restricting above-highwall disturbance, defining steep slope above twenty degrees, and exempting occasional steep slopes on flat terrain.

headings.title: Variance from steep-slope contour restoration requirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a commission variance from steep-slope approximate original contour restoration upon written surface-owner request for industrial, commercial, residential, or public uses meeting five specified conditions.

headings.title: Variance petition, director investigation, and hearing rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a variance petition with the director for investigation and recommendation, providing a thirty-day section 444.690 hearing right upon adverse recommendation or aggrieved-party petition with the burden on the petitioner.

headings.title: Annual concurrency and extension of variances
headings.reviewNote: Provides that variances run concurrently with the permit year and may be extended annually by affirmative commission action only if the operator demonstrates development proceeding per the reclamation plan.

headings.title: Variance terms, revocation, and modification after hearing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes imposing compliance conditions on variances and revoking or modifying variances for noncompliance after a section 444.690 hearing on at least thirty days' written notice.

headings.title: Exemptions for noncommercial, incidental, and small coal extraction
headings.reviewNote: Exempts landowner noncommercial coal extraction, incidental government-financed construction, incidental extraction of up to sixteen and two-thirds percent coal tonnage, and operations removing no more than two hundred fifty tons in twelve consecutive months.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.535 governing coal strip mining rules, steep-slope standards, approximate original contour variances, variance petitions and terms, and statutory exemptions.

headings.title: Annual strip mining permit required
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits strip mining without a commission permit issued on a calendar-year basis (valid until December 31 if effective after January 1), requiring a separate permit for each mine.

headings.title: Permit fee schedule and calculation
headings.reviewNote: Requires a three-hundred-fifty-dollar basic fee plus thirty-five dollars per acre or fraction thereof before permit issuance.

headings.title: Annual renewal and permit terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual permit renewal for uncompleted mining or reclamation by submitting a renewal form, three-hundred-fifty-dollar fee, and section 444.570 bond.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 3 subsection headings for 444.540 establishing annual strip mining permit requirements, acreage fee schedules, and renewal procedures.

headings.title: Permit application form contents and access consent
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required application disclosures including interest holders, source of legal mining right, addresses, other permits, and written access consent for the commission or director.

headings.title: Certified engineer map and water management plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires an accompanying map certified by a professional engineer showing boundaries, nearby owners and features within six hundred sixty feet, cropline, acreage, and a comprehensive water management plan.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.550 governing strip mining permit application form disclosures and certified professional engineer maps.

headings.title: Permit amendment to cover additional land
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes an operator to file an amended application with required additional fee and bond for an amendment covering additional land.

headings.title: Withdrawal of unaffected land and proportionate bond reduction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes an operator to withdraw any land covered by a permit except affected land upon notice to the commission, with proportionate bond or security reduction.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.580 governing permit amendments to add land and withdrawal of unaffected land with bond reduction.

headings.title: Director investigation, thirty-day decision, and notice
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to investigate permit applications, decide within thirty days, notify the applicant, publish newspaper notice, notify section 444.720 registrants, and deems the decision appealable to the administrative hearing commission.

headings.title: Administrative hearing commission appeal and court of appeals review
headings.reviewNote: Grants any aggrieved person thirty days to appeal permit issuance, denial, suspension, or revocation to the administrative hearing commission under scientific-evidence and five-year noncompliance standards, followed by commission decision and original court of appeals review under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.600 governing director investigation and thirty-day permit decisions, administrative hearing commission appeals, and court of appeals judicial review.

headings.title: Mandatory reclamation and grading standards
headings.reviewNote: Establishes grading, soil replacement, vegetative cover, water impoundment, and acid drainage prevention requirements.

headings.title: Timelines for completing reclamation
headings.reviewNote: Requires commencing reclamation as soon as possible, completing grading within twelve months after permit expiration, and completing seeding and planting within twenty-four months with survival by the second growing season.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 subsection headings for 444.610 governing substantive reclamation standards and statutory completion deadlines.

headings.title: Post-expiration affected acreage and reclamation report
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a report within sixty days after permit expiration stating exact acres affected and reclamation already accomplished.

headings.title: Grading completion report and deadline
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a report within thirty days after grading is completed or sixty days after twelve months from permit expiration stating the extent of grading.

headings.title: Revegetation planting report and deadline
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a planting report within thirty days after revegetation is completed or due to be completed showing the extent of revegetation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.630 governing post-expiration affected-acreage reports, grading reports, and revegetation planting reports.

headings.title: Departmental inspection of reported reclamation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to investigate the status of reclamation after each report referred to in section 444.580 (as cited verbatim in source text) is filed.

headings.title: Release of up to two-thirds bond after grading
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to release up to two-thirds of the bond per completed acre upon determining that grading has been satisfactorily completed.

headings.title: Release of remaining bond after revegetation
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to release the remainder of the bond per completed acre upon determining that revegetation has been satisfactorily completed.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.640 governing commission reclamation investigations and staged bond release after grading and revegetation.

headings.title: Operator application for bond release
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes operators to file formal applications requesting release of performance bonds after completing reclamation.

headings.title: Uncontested release order and third-party opposition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes bond release without hearing unless an aggrieved party files a timely petition in opposition.

headings.title: Commission denial of release and operator hearing
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice stating reasons upon bond release denial and grants operators thirty days to request a hearing.

headings.title: Right of appeal from bond release orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any party to the proceeding to appeal commission bond release orders under section 444.700.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 subsection headings for 444.650 governing bond release applications, third-party objections, denial hearings, and judicial review.

headings.title: Injunction and penalties for unpermitted mining
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes suits for injunctions and civil penalties up to one thousand dollars per day for unpermitted operations.

headings.title: Conciliation, formal complaint, and hearing notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides for informal conciliation, formal complaints, and hearing notices specifying alleged permit violations.

headings.title: Hearing rights of respondent
headings.reviewNote: Grants respondents the right to appear with counsel, introduce evidence, and cross-examine adverse witnesses.

headings.title: Final order of commission following hearing
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to enter appropriate final orders or determinations following hearing or default.

headings.title: Majority approval requirement and reissuance restriction
headings.reviewNote: Requires written approval of four members for final orders and bars permit issuance until violations are resolved.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 5 subsection headings for 444.680 governing unpermitted mining injunctions, complaint procedures, respondent hearing rights, final determinations, and member approval thresholds.

headings.title: Exhaustion of remedies and judicial review
headings.reviewNote: Subjects final commission orders to judicial review under chapter 536 after exhausting administrative remedies.

headings.title: Review of rule validity and additional evidence
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts reviewing rule validity under section 536.050 to examine the record and take additional evidence.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 subsection headings for 444.700 establishing administrative exhaustion prerequisites for judicial review and judicial evidence standards.

headings.title: Public notice and hearing prior to rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days' published and mailed notice and a public hearing prior to adopting, amending, or repealing rules.

headings.title: Public participation and written comments
headings.reviewNote: Affords interested persons opportunity to speak at hearings and submit written statements within seven days thereafter.

headings.title: Four-member written approval and secretary filing
headings.reviewNote: Requires written approval by at least four commission members and filing with the secretary of state before rules take effect.

headings.title: Geographic and topographic rule distinctions permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to adopt rule terms differing based on topography and regional conditions.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 subsection headings for 444.720 governing rulemaking notice requirements, public participation, approval and filing thresholds, and regional variations.

headings.title: Creation and revenue sources of fund
headings.reviewNote: Credits all fees and forfeited bonds collected under sections 444.500 to 444.970 to the mined land reclamation fund.

headings.title: Permissible expenditures and investment of moneys
headings.reviewNote: Restricts appropriated fund expenditures to administration, enforcement, and land reclamation, directs state treasurer investment, and exempts balances from section 33.080 lapse except amounts exceeding three million dollars exclusive of interest and forfeitures.

headings.title: Expenditure of forfeited bond moneys
headings.reviewNote: Dedicates forfeited bond funds specifically to reclaiming the lands on which the bonds were forfeited.

headings.title: General revenue appropriations for administration and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appropriating or expending state general revenue for the administration or enforcement of sections 444.500 to 444.970.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.730 creating the Mined Land Reclamation Fund and governing expenditures, investment, lapse thresholds, bond forfeitures, and general revenue appropriations.

headings.title: Use and compensation of state and federal agency services
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to use and compensate other state or federal agencies for services in reclaiming strip-mined land.

headings.title: Receipt of funds, competitive contracts, and right of access
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes receiving federal, state, or other reclamation funds, performing work through employees, agencies, soil conservation districts, or lowest-responsible-bidder contracts, and grants reasonable right of access.

headings.title: Reclamation of unbonded strip-mined lands
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes expending available funds or public works programs to reclaim and rehabilitate strip-mined lands not meeting statutory standards and not covered by bond.

headings.title: Third-party bond assumption and operator bond release
headings.reviewNote: Permits a qualified person or organization to post bond or cash deposit and assume approved reclamation plan liability after mining and grading are completed, releasing the operator's bond.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.740 governing interagency reclamation services, funding and competitive contracts, unbonded land reclamation, and third-party reclamation bond assumption.

headings.title: Inapplicability to noncommercial construction and land improvement excavations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts excavation of minerals or fill dirt for construction or land improvement unrelated to commercial mining or post-mining reclamation from sections 444.760 to 444.790.

headings.title: Permit exemptions for construction, land improvement, and fill dirt
headings.reviewNote: Exempts moving or removing minerals or fill dirt without a permit for licensed-plan or contracted construction, qualifying unbeneficiated excess-mineral land improvement, and any fill-dirt excavation.

headings.title: Procedure for contesting director permit-requirement determinations
headings.reviewNote: Establishes certified mail notice, fifteen-day informal conference, thirty-day director and commission written determinations, continued site activity pending final decision, and exemption from section 444.789 hearing requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.766 governing construction, land improvement, and fill-dirt exemptions from surface mining permits and contested permit-requirement determinations.

headings.title: Comprehensive fee and bond review, rulemaking, and 2030 expiration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the DNR director to conduct stakeholder reviews and propose fee, bond, or assessment changes for two-thirds commission approval and rulemaking by December 1 (subject to General Assembly sixty-day disapproval), with revision authority expiring August 28, 2030.

headings.title: Late fees, interest, and circuit court collection actions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a fifteen-percent late fee plus ten-percent annual interest for unpaid fees, bonds, or assessments and permits department circuit court collection actions for unpaid amounts, attorney's fees, and costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.768 governing comprehensive fee/bond/assessment reviews and rulemaking (authority expiring August 28, 2030 per source note) and late fees/collection actions.

headings.title: Surface mining permit requirement including small gravel operations
headings.reviewNote: Makes surface mining without a commission permit unlawful, including gravel operations under five thousand tons annually except as provided in subsection 2.

headings.title: Seasonal gravel accretion and political subdivision exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts qualifying seasonal gravel accretion removal (under two thousand tons annually, one thousand tons per site, with annual notice if sold, watershed plan if threshold reached, and setback limits) and political subdivision sand and gravel contracts for sole municipal use.

headings.title: Applicability dates for opened areas and newly covered minerals
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 444.760 to 444.790 only to areas opened or extended on or after January 1, 1972, with an August 28, 1990 effective date for newly covered minerals.

headings.title: Exemption and registration for government-regulated operations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts post-September 28, 1971 operations under government agency regulations equal to or greater than section 444.774, while requiring registration with the Missouri Mining Commission.

headings.title: Solid waste landfill exemption, permit cancellation, and bond release
headings.reviewNote: Exempts surface mining areas permitted under solid waste sections 260.200 to 260.245, directing permit cancellation and bond release upon evidence of section 260.205, 260.226, and 260.227 compliance and landfill commencement.

headings.title: In-stream gravel exemption for political subdivisions and personal use
headings.reviewNote: Exempts political subdivisions using their own personnel and equipment and private individuals for personal use conducting in-stream gravel operations from permit requirements.

headings.title: Violation complaint identification and confidentiality
headings.reviewNote: Requires complainants to provide name, phone number, violation date and location, and adequate information, and keeps complaint records and communications confidential for sole departmental investigation use.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.770 governing surface mining permit mandates, seasonal gravel accretion and political subdivision exemptions, effective dates, solid waste transitions, personal in-stream gravel removal, and complaint confidentiality.

headings.title: Written permit application to director
headings.reviewNote: Requires any operator desiring to engage in surface mining to submit a written permit application to the director.

headings.title: Prescribed application form contents and access consent
headings.reviewNote: Specifies seven required application items including interest holders, mining right source, addresses, other permits, written access consent (with operator-only consent under ten thousand tons), tract description, and estimated twelve-month acreage.

headings.title: Accompanying map in commission-specified scale and form
headings.reviewNote: Requires the permit application to be accompanied by a map in a scale and form specified by commission regulation.

headings.title: Bond, geologic resources fee, and permit fee structure
headings.reviewNote: Requires a section 444.778 bond, section 256.700 geologic resources fee, and permit, site, and acreage fees (capped at three thousand dollars, or three hundred dollars for under-five-thousand-ton gravel), plus an annual director staffing and activity report.

headings.title: Permit amendment to cover additional land
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes filing an amended application with required additional fee and bond, directing the director to issue an amendment upon regulatory compliance.

headings.title: Withdrawal of unaffected land and bond reduction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes withdrawing non-affected land from a permit by notifying the commission, with proportionate reduction of bond or security.

headings.title: Annual permit renewal and prorated extensions
headings.reviewNote: Requires renewing permits for uncompleted mining or reclamation with a renewal form and fee (capped at three thousand dollars, or three hundred dollars for small gravel), allowing approved partial-year prorated extensions.

headings.title: Successor operator liability assumption and release
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to release a predecessor operator when both operators hold permits, comply with statutory requirements, and the successor assumes all reclamation liability.

headings.title: Accompanying reclamation plan and verified statement
headings.reviewNote: Requires a reclamation plan containing a verified operator statement setting forth proposed operation, reclamation, and conservation plans with approximate completion dates.

headings.title: Public notice, certified mailings, and public meeting requests
headings.reviewNote: Deems applications complete after forty-five days without response, requires four-week newspaper notice and certified mail to local governments and landowners within one-half mile and adjacent, and grants fifteen days to comment or request an applicant-funded public meeting.

headings.title: Director authority to approve plan exceptions or variances
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to approve permit or amendment plans deviating from statutory requirements when site conditions warrant an exception under regulatory criteria.

headings.title: Effective date and December 31, 2030 expiration of fees
headings.reviewNote: Provides that fees under this section take effect August 28, 2007 and expire December 31, 2030, while no other provisions of this section expire.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.772 governing surface mining permit applications, fees (expiring December 31, 2030 per source note), amendments, withdrawals, renewals, successors, reclamation plans, public notice, and variances.

headings.title: Director investigation, six-week decision, and permit conditions
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to investigate applications, decide within six weeks after section 444.772.10 notice considering public comments, allows seeking additional information or imposing conditions, and makes the decision appealable to the administrative hearing commission.

headings.title: Administrative hearing commission appeal and court of appeals review
headings.reviewNote: Grants aggrieved persons thirty days to appeal permit issuance, denial, suspension, or revocation to the administrative hearing commission under scientific-evidence and five-year noncompliance criteria, followed by commission decision and original court of appeals review under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.773 governing director permit investigations and six-week decisions, administrative hearing commission appeals, and court of appeals review; source cross-reference notes nonseverability clause in section 640.099.

headings.title: Twelve substantive surface mining reclamation requirements
headings.reviewNote: Establishes twelve conditions including rolling-topography grading, erosion and barite-pit controls, tar sands disposal, wildlife leveling, lateral-support setbacks, three-foot barriers, earth dams, acid/tar-sand cover, postmining uses, plantings, and floodplain exemptions.

headings.title: Reclamation commencement, grading, and revegetation timelines
headings.reviewNote: Requires commencing reclamation after mining viable mineral reserves, completing grading within twelve months, and completing seeding and planting within twenty-four months with survival by the second growing season.

headings.title: Substitution of previously mined unreclaimed land
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes operators, with director approval and written landowner approval on leased land, to substitute equal acreage of previously mined unreclaimed land with conforming map and reclamation plan.

headings.title: Post-expiration affected acreage and reclamation report
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a report within sixty days after permit expiration stating the exact number of affected acres and extent of reclamation accomplished.

headings.title: Topsoil or approved rooting medium cover requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires covering revegetated affected land with sufficient topsoil or approved rooting medium, exempting wildlife areas under subsection 1(4) and planned industrial-use areas.

headings.title: Commission extensions of completion dates for good cause
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to grant additional time to meet completion dates due to act of God, war, strike, riot, catastrophe, or other good cause shown.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.774 governing surface mining reclamation standards, completion timelines, land substitution, post-expiration reports, topsoil cover, and time extensions.

headings.title: Operator application for bond release
headings.reviewNote: Requires an operator to apply to the commission for bond release with or after the section 444.774 completion report.

headings.title: Commission investigation of reclamation status
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to cause an investigation of reclamation status on land subject to a bond release application.

headings.title: Release order without hearing and discretionary opposition hearings
headings.reviewNote: Permits releasing a bond without hearing, and authorizes a section 444.789 hearing if an affected landowner petitions in opposition within thirty days (where criteria are unmet) or if the director recommends denial within thirty days.

headings.title: Denial order, thirty-day operator hearing request, and burden
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing a reasoned denial order with notice and holding a section 444.789 hearing if requested by the operator within thirty days, placing the burden of proof on the operator.

headings.title: Judicial review under chapter 536 after exhaustion
headings.reviewNote: Subjects final commission decisions or orders to chapter 536 judicial review only after all administrative remedies are exhausted.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.775 governing bond release applications, reclamation investigations, uncontested release or opposition hearings, denial hearings, and chapter 536 judicial review.

headings.title: Bond form, amount per acre, and collateral alternatives
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes surety bond requirements, penal sums per acre, topsoil bonding, letters of credit, and gravel mining rates.

headings.title: Bond duration and denial for prior forfeiture
headings.reviewNote: Maintains bond in effect until reclamation is released, and makes forfeiture cause for denying future permits.

headings.title: Surety cancellation notice period
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits surety bond cancellation without at least ninety days' prior written notice to the commission.

headings.title: Replacement of surety and permit suspension
headings.reviewNote: Requires substituting a qualified surety within sixty days of cancellation and authorizes permit suspension upon failure.

headings.title: Violation notice and bond forfeiture proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice of violations and authorizes bond forfeiture if corrective actions are not commenced in ninety days.

headings.title: Commission power of reclamation and right of entry
headings.reviewNote: Grants the commission, contractors, and operators right of entry to reclaim lands subject to forfeited bonds.

headings.title: Obligation discharge and proportional bond reduction
headings.reviewNote: Requires releasing operator obligations and reducing bond penalty amounts upon completing reclamation requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 7 subsection headings for 444.778 establishing bond forms and rates, duration, cancellation notices, surety replacement, forfeiture procedures, state reclamation authority, and bond discharge.

headings.title: Civil suit for unpermitted surface mining
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes requests to the attorney general to seek injunctions and civil penalties up to one thousand dollars per day.

headings.title: Violation notice, informal conference, and formal complaint
headings.reviewNote: Provides for informal conferences, formal complaints, and hearing requests within fifteen days of complaint service.

headings.title: Commission final order and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to enter final orders, cease-and-desist orders, or permit revocations following hearing or default.

headings.title: Four-member approval, reissuance bar, and judicial review
headings.reviewNote: Requires four written member approvals, bars reissuance until violations are cured, and provides chapter 536 appeals.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 subsection headings for 444.787 covering unpermitted mining civil suits, complaint and conference procedures, final orders, and member approval rules.

headings.title: Contested case of record requirement
headings.reviewNote: Designates hearings under this section as contested cases of record.

headings.title: Procedural rights of participating parties
headings.reviewNote: Grants parties the right to make oral arguments, present evidence, and cross-examine witnesses.

headings.title: Hearing officers and final commission decision
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes hearing officer designation while reserving final decision-making power to the full commission.

headings.title: Notice of hearing and subpoena powers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuing notices of hearing and subpoenas pursuant to section 536.077.

headings.title: Application of civil discovery rules
headings.reviewNote: Applies rules of discovery from civil cases to administrative hearings held under this section.

headings.title: Inapplicability of contested procedures to public meetings
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that contested case procedures do not apply to informal public meetings under section 444.773.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 6 subsection headings for 444.789 governing contested case hearings, party rights, hearing officer assignments, subpoenas, discovery rules, and public meeting exemptions.

headings.title: Assessment criteria and minor violation restriction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative penalties after conference, conciliation, and persuasion, prohibits penalties for minor violations, and directs the commission to define minor violation by rule.

headings.title: Penalty matrix rules, payment deadline, and surcharge
headings.reviewNote: Requires penalty matrix rules reflecting RCRA 42 U.S.C. 6928(a), sets a sixty-day payment deadline stayed by commission appeal, imposes a fifteen-percent surcharge plus ten-percent annual interest, credits general revenue, and authorizes circuit court collection.

headings.title: Limitation on increased penalties and two-year discovery rule
headings.reviewNote: Bars penalty increases caused by agency delay and requires penalty assessment within two years of discovery.

headings.title: Judicial review and right to trial de novo
headings.reviewNote: Subjects final administrative penalty orders to judicial review under section 536.100, while allowing either party to require a trial de novo in the circuit court where the violation occurred.

headings.title: Election of remedies and habitual violator exception
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes electing administrative or civil penalties, bars subsequent monetary/civil penalties for the same violation except for department-determined habitual violators, and directs rulemaking to clarify habitual violator.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.790 governing surface mining administrative penalties, penalty matrix rules, two-year limitations, trial de novo judicial review, and civil election with habitual-violator exception; source notes record three original-rolls word discrepancies ('of', 'whom', 'to').

headings.title: Short title of surface coal mining law
headings.reviewNote: Designates sections 444.800 to 444.940 as the Surface Coal Mining Law.

headings.title: Legislative findings on surface coal mining
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth five general assembly findings on coal extraction, energy needs, adverse surface mining impacts, environmental standards, and reclamation technology.

headings.title: Statutory purposes of Surface Coal Mining Law
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates eight statutory purposes including minimizing injurious effects, protecting surface owners, preventing infeasible mining, contemporaneous reclamation, balancing energy and environment, reclaiming pre-August 3, 1977 lands, and public participation.

headings.title: Enforcement directive and federal stringency limitation
headings.reviewNote: Directs rigid enforcement and rulemaking no more stringent than comparable federal OSMRE regulations under P.L. 95-87 unless affirmatively shown essential.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.800 establishing the Surface Coal Mining Law short title, legislative findings, statutory purposes, and federal-stringency rulemaking limits.

headings.title: Enumerated powers of commission over coal mining
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates fourteen commission powers including rulemaking, research, permits, inspections, hearings, revocations, forfeitures, injunctions, staffing, pre-August 3, 1977 reclamation, creating the non-lapsing Abandoned Mine Reclamation Fund, and federal-lands cooperative agreements.

headings.title: Rulemaking effectiveness pursuant to section 536.024
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no rule or portion of a rule promulgated under sections 444.800 to 444.970 becomes effective unless promulgated pursuant to section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.810 enumerating commission surface coal mining powers (including creating the Abandoned Mine Reclamation Fund) and section 536.024 rulemaking effectiveness.

headings.title: Mandatory surface coal mining permit
headings.reviewNote: Requires permits under this law eight months after federal approval of the state program, with transitional continuation of pre-September 28, 1979 permits under sections 444.500 to 444.755.

headings.title: Five-year permit term and successor continuation
headings.reviewNote: Limits permit terms to five years unless a longer term is demonstrated necessary for financing, and allows a successor applying within thirty days with original bond coverage to continue operations pending decision.

headings.title: Termination for failure to commence mining
headings.reviewNote: Terminates a permit if mining operations do not commence within three years, subject to reasonable extensions.

headings.title: Right of successive permit renewal
headings.reviewNote: Grants a right of successive renewal within existing boundaries (placing the burden on opponents), lists five written-finding denial grounds, applies new-permit standards to boundary extensions, and requires renewal applications at least one hundred twenty days before expiration.

headings.title: Compliance by government agencies and public utilities
headings.reviewNote: Requires federal, state, and local government agencies, units, instrumentalities, and publicly owned utilities or corporations conducting surface coal mining to comply with sections 444.815 to 444.905.

headings.title: Exemptions for noncommercial and incidental coal extraction
headings.reviewNote: Exempts landowner noncommercial coal extraction, incidental government-financed highway or construction extraction, and incidental coal extraction not exceeding sixteen and two-thirds percent of commercial mineral tonnage.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.815 governing surface coal mining permit mandates, five-year terms and successors, three-year commencement termination, renewals, government operator compliance, and statutory exemptions.

headings.title: Application fee schedule for coal mining
headings.reviewNote: Imposes permit application fees based on base filing charges and acreage proposed to be mined.

headings.title: Comprehensive application disclosures and maps
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required applicant identity, compliance history, legal rights, cultural resources, and geological maps.

headings.title: Public access and confidentiality of coal analysis data
headings.reviewNote: Makes coal seam, test boring, core sampling, and soil data available to adversely affected persons while keeping purely chemical and physical coal analysis confidential except potentially toxic content.

headings.title: Assistance program for small coal operators
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission-funded hydrologic consequence determinations and test boring statements by a designated laboratory upon written request of operators whose probable annual production will not exceed one hundred thousand tons.

headings.title: Mandatory reclamation plan submission
headings.reviewNote: Requires each permit applicant to submit a reclamation plan meeting the requirements of this law as part of the permit application.

headings.title: Simultaneous county recorder filing for public inspection
headings.reviewNote: Requires each applicant, simultaneous with commission filing, to file a copy of the application (excluding coal seam information) for public inspection with the county recorder of deeds.

headings.title: Public liability insurance certificate requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires submitting a certificate of public liability insurance covering personal injury and property damage (including explosives) maintained throughout the permit, renewals, and reclamation.

headings.title: Blasting plan submission requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires each permit applicant to submit a blasting plan outlining procedures and standards to satisfy section 444.855.2(15).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.820 governing permit fees, application disclosures, coal-analysis confidentiality, small-operator lab assistance, reclamation plans, county recorder filing, public liability insurance, and blasting plans; source cross-reference cites section 444.835.

headings.title: Mandatory contents of coal mine reclamation plan
headings.reviewNote: Specifies engineering plans, timing, post-mining land use, soil handling, revegetation, and hydrologic protection measures.

headings.title: Confidentiality of nonpublic reclamation plan information
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to hold in confidence any information required by this section that is not on public file pursuant to this law.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 2 subsection headings for 444.825 detailing mandatory reclamation plan components and confidentiality protections for proprietary data.

headings.title: Phase I reclamation bond filing and minimum amount
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing a section 444.950 Phase I reclamation bond (and incremental bonds) before permit issuance sufficient with the coal mine land reclamation fund to complete reclamation, with a ten-thousand-dollar minimum.

headings.title: Bond liability duration, corporate surety, and collateral options
headings.reviewNote: Extends bond liability through mining, reclamation, and the section 444.855 revegetation period, requiring a licensed corporate surety or cash, irrevocable letters of credit, U.S./Missouri bonds, or negotiable certificates of deposit.

headings.title: Self-bonding without surety and alternative bonding systems
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes accepting an applicant's self-bond upon showing a service agent and financial solvency, or adopting an alternative bonding system consistent with P.L. 95-87.

headings.title: Periodic adjustment of bond amount and terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to adjust bond amounts and acceptance terms as affected acreages increase or decrease or future reclamation costs change.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.830 governing Phase I reclamation bonds, liability duration and acceptable collateral, self-bonding or alternative bonding systems, and periodic bond adjustments.

headings.title: Permit decision, applicant burden, and local official notice
headings.reviewNote: Directs granting, requiring modification of, or denying a permit with written notice (placing compliance burden on the applicant) and requires notifying local officials within ten days after granting a permit.

headings.title: Mandatory written findings for permit approval
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits permit approval without written findings of completeness, reclamation feasibility, cumulative hydrologic impact assessment, non-unsuitability under section 444.890, and severed mineral estate consent, grant, or court decree.

headings.title: Schedule of prior environmental violations
headings.reviewNote: Requires a three-year environmental violation schedule and bars permit issuance for uncorrected violations or after a hearing finding a pattern of willful violations causing irreparable environmental damage.

headings.title: Prime farmland mining standards and grandfathering
headings.reviewNote: Requires written findings of technological capability to restore prime farmland after U.S. Secretary of Agriculture consultation, exempting permits and existing operations issued prior to September 28, 1979.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.835 governing permit decisions and local notice, mandatory written approval findings, three-year violation schedules, and prime farmland standards.

headings.title: Permit revision application and scale guidelines
headings.reviewNote: Governs applications for permit revisions, scale thresholds requiring public hearings, and boundary extension rules.

headings.title: Prior approval for transfer, assignment, or sale
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the transfer, assignment, or sale of permit rights without prior written approval from the commission.

headings.title: Mandatory periodic commission review of permits
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to review outstanding permits and authorizes requiring reasonable permit modifications.

headings.title: Successor operator liability and predecessor release
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes releasing predecessor operators from liability when qualifying successors assume full reclamation bonds.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 4 subsection headings for 444.840 governing permit revision procedures, transfer approvals, periodic permit reviews, and successor liability assumptions.

headings.title: Permit and bond for land-disturbing coal exploration
headings.reviewNote: Requires exploration permits, performance standards compliance, and minimum one-thousand-dollar bonds for land disturbances.

headings.title: Confidentiality of commercial trade secrets
headings.reviewNote: Shields confidential commercial information and competitive trade secrets submitted in exploration filings from public view.

headings.title: Penalties for unauthorized exploration disturbances
headings.reviewNote: Subjects persons conducting exploration activities that disturb land in violation of rules to statutory penalties.

headings.title: Two-hundred-fifty-ton coal removal ceiling
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits removing more than two hundred and fifty tons of coal under an exploration permit without commission approval.

headings.title: Rulemaking modifications for coal exploration
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to promulgate rules adapting general permit and bonding requirements to exploration operations.

entries.reviewSummary: Drafted 5 subsection headings for 444.845 establishing coal exploration permit mandates, confidentiality protections, violation penalties, tonnage limits, and specialized exploration rules.

headings.title: Newspaper publication and local government notification
headings.reviewNote: Requires weekly newspaper notices and directs agency notification of mining applications for sixty-day comment.

headings.title: Sixty-day written objections and informal conference
headings.reviewNote: Grants adversely affected persons and agency heads sixty days to file written objections and allows requesting a local informal conference within thirty days, advertised two weeks in advance with a maintained record.

headings.title: Director written findings within sixty days after conference
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director, if an informal conference was held, to issue written findings granting, requiring modification of, or denying the permit within sixty days and furnish copies to all parties.

headings.title: Director written findings when no conference is held
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director, if no informal conference was held, to issue written findings granting, requiring modification of, or denying the permit within sixty days after the last newspaper publication.

headings.title: Permit issuance, formal contested hearing, and commission decision
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuing approved permits or stating disapproval reasons, grants thirty days to request a contested-case commission hearing held within thirty days (with optional hearing officer), and requires a written commission decision within thirty days thereafter.

headings.title: Temporary relief pending formal hearing determination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to grant temporary relief pending final determination if all parties are heard, the requester shows substantial likelihood of prevailing, and no adverse public health, safety, or imminent environmental harm will result.

headings.title: Commission and hearing officer powers and verbatim record
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administering oaths, issuing subpoenas, compelling attendance and production, taking evidence including site inspections, and requires a verbatim hearing record and transcript upon motion or order.

headings.title: Right to appeal commission decisions or inaction
headings.reviewNote: Grants participating aggrieved applicants and adversely affected persons the right to appeal commission decisions or failures to act within time limits under section 444.900.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.850 governing public notice, objections and informal conferences, written findings, contested hearings, temporary relief, hearing powers, and appeals; source note cites Continental Coal, Inc. (2004) denying economic-competitor standing under subsection 8.

headings.title: General performance standards requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires all surface coal mining and reclamation operations to meet comprehensive statutory environmental performance standards.

headings.title: Enumerated environmental performance standards
headings.reviewNote: Details twenty-five minimum standards including resource conservation, postmining uses, approximate original contour, topsoil, prime farmland, impoundments, augering, hydrologic balance, waste piles, underground-mine setbacks, explosives/blasting, contemporaneous reclamation, roads, revegetation, excess spoil, and natural barriers.

headings.title: Mountaintop removal permits without original contour restoration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes permits removing entire upper coal seams to create a plateau or gently rolling contour without highwalls for equal-or-better postmining uses, subject to engineering, sixty-day local comment, stability, and three-year review.

headings.title: Steep-slope surface coal mining performance standards
headings.reviewNote: Establishes additional standards for slopes above twenty degrees barring downslope debris, requiring complete highwall backfilling and limited above-highwall disturbance, while exempting flat/gently rolling terrain and subsection 3 permits.

headings.title: Contour restoration variances upon surface owner request
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes permits without approximate original contour restoration upon written surface-owner request for industrial, commercial, residential, or public uses with improved watershed control, highwall backfilling, engineer certification, DNR approval, and three-year review.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.855 governing general surface coal mining performance standards (including explosives in subsection 2(15)), mountaintop removal permits, steep-slope standards, and approximate original contour variances.

headings.title: Rulemaking standards for underground coal mining
headings.reviewNote: Directs promulgating performance standards to mitigate surface impacts from underground coal mining and subsidence.

headings.title: Underground coal mining permit performance requirements
headings.reviewNote: Lists twelve mandatory permit requirements including subsidence prevention, sealing portals and holes, waste pile stabilization, dams, vegetation, offsite protection, fire-hazard elimination, hydrologic balance, surface roads/facilities, wildlife protection, and drift-mine gravity discharge prevention.

headings.title: Suspension of underground mining under urbanized areas
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to suspend underground coal mining under urbanized areas, cities, towns, and communities and adjacent to industrial/commercial buildings, major impoundments, or permanent streams upon finding imminent danger to inhabitants.

headings.title: Application of law to underground surface impacts and rules
headings.reviewNote: Applies this law to surface operations and impacts incident to underground coal mines with commission-promulgated rule modifications accommodating differences between surface and underground mining.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.860 governing underground coal mining surface-effect rules, permit requirements, urban-area mining suspension, and adapted law applicability.

headings.title: Operator recordkeeping, monitoring, and reporting duties
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining records, installing monitoring equipment, and submitting periodic reports on environmental impacts.

headings.title: Right of entry and unannounced inspections
headings.reviewNote: Grants commission staff right of entry without advance notice to inspect operations, records, and monitoring equipment.

headings.title: Minimum inspection frequency for active operations
headings.reviewNote: Mandates at least one partial inspection per month and one complete inspection per quarter for each permitted site.

headings.title: Prohibition on obstructing inspections and search warrants
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits refusing entry or obstructing commission inspectors and requires courts to issue suitably restricted search warrants upon written probable-cause oath or affirmation.

headings.title: Conspicuous permittee identification sign at mine entrances
headings.reviewNote: Requires each permittee to conspicuously maintain a clearly visible entrance sign displaying the permittee's name, business address, phone number, and permit number.

headings.title: Inspector written notice and report of detected violations
headings.reviewNote: Requires each inspector detecting a violation to forthwith inform the operator in writing and report the violation in writing to the commission.

headings.title: Immediate public availability of records and inspection materials
headings.reviewNote: Requires making copies of commission records, reports, and inspection materials immediately available to the public at convenient county, multicounty, and state locations.

headings.title: Employee financial interest ban, penalty, and disclosure rules
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits commission employees from holding direct or indirect financial interests in coal mining (misdemeanor up to two thousand five hundred dollars fine and/or one year imprisonment) and directs financial-statement monitoring rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.865 governing permittee recordkeeping and monitoring, inspection entry and frequency, search warrants, entrance signs, violation reporting, public access, and employee financial-interest bans.

headings.title: Discretionary and mandatory administrative penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative penalties up to five thousand dollars per violation (mandatory if a section 444.885 cessation order results), treating each continuing day as a separate violation and listing four assessment factors.

headings.title: Public hearing opportunity and written commission decision
headings.reviewNote: Requires opportunity for a contested-case public hearing (with optional hearing officer) and written findings, conclusions, and decision before assessing an administrative penalty.

headings.title: Violation notice, thirty-day hearing request, and penalty bond
headings.reviewNote: Directs registered-mail notice of proposed penalties, grants thirty days to request a hearing accompanied by a certificate-of-deposit penalty bond (waiving contest rights if unfiled), and requires thirty-day release with at least six-percent or Treasury interest if reduced or vacated.

headings.title: Civil recovery of administrative penalties, interest, and fees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the attorney general at commission request to recover unpaid administrative penalties, at least six-percent or Treasury interest, and attorney's fees in local or Cole County circuit court.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for willful permit or order violations
headings.reviewNote: Punishes willful and knowing violation of permit conditions or section 444.885, 444.900, or final commission orders (excluding subsection 2 orders) by up to a ten-thousand-dollar fine and/or one year imprisonment.

headings.title: Corporate officer liability for corporate violations
headings.reviewNote: Subjects corporate directors, officers, or agents who willfully and knowingly authorized, ordered, or carried out corporate permit or order violations to the same administrative penalties, fines, and imprisonment.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for knowing false statements or omissions
headings.reviewNote: Punishes knowingly making false statements, representations, or certifications—or knowingly failing to make required ones—in any filed or maintained document by up to a ten-thousand-dollar fine and/or one year imprisonment.

headings.title: Mandatory daily administrative penalty for failure to abate
headings.reviewNote: Mandates an administrative penalty of seven hundred fifty to five thousand dollars per day for failing to correct a section 444.885.1 cited violation within the abatement period (tolled during court or commission suspension orders).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.870 governing surface coal mining administrative penalties, contested hearings, penalty bonds, collection suits, criminal offenses, corporate officer liability, and failure-to-abate penalties; source note records original-rolls word discrepancy ('of') in subsection 8.

headings.title: Filing bond release application and public advertisement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes bond release requests accompanied by four-week newspaper advertisements, copies of letters to adjoining owners, local bodies, and water companies, and (for post-September 1, 1992 phase I lands) a recorded county affidavit at phase III release.

headings.title: Thirty-day inspection and written release decision
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission inspection and evaluation within thirty days and written release decision within sixty days of filing (or thirty days after a subsection 6 public hearing).

headings.title: Three-phase performance bond release schedule
headings.reviewNote: Permits releasing up to sixty percent after backfilling, regrading, and drainage; a portion after revegetation subject to suspended-solids and prime-farmland standards; and the remainder after the section 444.855 responsibility period.

headings.title: Written disapproval notice and corrective action recommendations
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice stating reasons for disapproving bond release, recommending corrective actions, and allowing opportunity for a public hearing if none was held.

headings.title: Certified mail notice to county and municipality
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to notify the county and/or municipality where the coal operation is located by certified mail within thirty days of a bond release filing.

headings.title: Sixty-day written objections and public hearing
headings.reviewNote: Grants affected persons and government agencies sixty days to file written objections and request a public hearing advertised for two weeks and held within ninety days in the locality or Cole County.

headings.title: Hearing powers, verbatim record, and hearing officer
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the commission to administer oaths, issue subpoenas, inspect lands, maintain a verbatim record, and designate a hearing officer while reserving final decisions to the commission.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.875 governing performance bond release requests, inspections and decisions, three-phase release schedule, disapprovals, local notice, written objections, and public hearing powers.

headings.title: Citizen suits to compel statutory compliance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any person with an adverse interest to commence a civil action to compel compliance with the law or permits.

headings.title: Sixty-day notice prerequisite for citizen suits
headings.reviewNote: Requires sixty days' prior written notice to the state and alleged violator before filing a citizen suit, with exceptions.

headings.title: Venue and commission intervention as of right
headings.reviewNote: Restricts venue for subsection 1(1) suits to the county where the surface coal mining operation is located and grants the commission intervention as a matter of right.

headings.title: Award of litigation costs and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes courts to award reasonable attorney fees and expert witness costs to any party whenever appropriate.

headings.title: Common law and statutory rights preserved
headings.reviewNote: Preserves all common law or statutory rights to seek relief against pollution or enforce statutory requirements.

headings.title: Private action for personal injury or property damages
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any person injured in person or property by an operator's violation of this law, rule, order, or permit to sue for damages (including attorney and expert fees) in the county of the operation, preserving workers' compensation laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.880 governing citizen compliance suits, sixty-day notice prerequisites, venue and commission intervention, litigation costs, preserved remedies, and private damage actions.

headings.title: Immediate cessation order for imminent environmental danger
headings.reviewNote: Directs immediate cessation orders upon finding conditions creating imminent danger to public health or serious environmental harm.

headings.title: Notice of violation and cessation order for nonabatement
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing notices of violation with abatement periods, and cessation orders if violations are not corrected.

headings.title: Show-cause order for pattern of violations
headings.reviewNote: Requires issuing a show-cause order with hearing opportunity upon finding a pattern of unwarranted or willful violations, and mandates suspending or revoking the permit upon failure to show cause.

headings.title: Notice contents, modification, and thirty-day cessation expiration
headings.reviewNote: Requires written, signed notices specifying violations and remedial actions, permits modification or vacation, and expires cessation orders after thirty days unless an on-site or nearby informal public hearing is held with a fifteen-day decision.

headings.title: Civil actions for injunctive and appropriate relief
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes requesting the attorney general to file civil actions for injunctions or restraining orders in six listed situations including order noncompliance, inspection refusal, and unpermitted mining.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 444.885 governing imminent-danger cessation orders, notices of violation, pattern-of-violation show-cause orders, notice contents and thirty-day expiration, and civil injunctive actions.

headings.title: Planning process and criteria for unsuitability designations
headings.reviewNote: Directs establishing an unsuitability planning process and database with mandatory and discretionary criteria, preserves mineral exploration, and exempts September 28, 1979 operations, permitted areas, and pre-January 4, 1977 substantial commitments.

headings.title: Citizen petition and hearing on unsuitability
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes adversely affected persons to petition to designate or terminate unsuitability, permits pre-hearing intervention, requires a local public hearing within ten months (unless withdrawn by stipulation), and requires a written decision within sixty days.

headings.title: Pre-designation impact statement on coal resources
headings.reviewNote: Requires preparing detailed statements on coal resources, demand, and economic impacts prior to unsuitability designations.

headings.title: Prohibited mining areas near parks, roads, and dwellings
